instruction:
Three applications are required for this CAE flow: AutoCAD -> SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. Use the AutoCAD 2024, SOLIDWORKS 2025, and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop as the three stages of this workflow. No init files are provided; start from blank files.

Handoff requirement: use the design token EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_02. In AutoCAD, add a readable label containing EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_02 and AUTOCAD_TO_SOLIDWORKS on a CHAIN layer in stage1_profile.dxf. In SolidWorks, keep EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_02, FROM_stage1_profile.dxf, and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS encoded in the part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage2_geometry.step contains them. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_02 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage2_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In AutoCAD, use drawing tools to create the 2D profile and save it as C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf. Draw an outer circle with diameter D120 on layer OUTLINE. Draw a centered D50 circle on layer CUTOUT as the boundary of the later blind recess. Draw eight D6 bolt holes on layer HOLE, evenly spaced on a 90 mm bolt circle.
2. In SolidWorks, import stage1_profile.dxf and create a 10 mm thick flange-cover solid. Cut only the eight D6 bolt holes through the full thickness. Use the centered D50 circle to create a 2 mm deep blind circular recess from the top face; the D50 recess must not pass through the flange. Export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step.
3. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage2_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-DxfFlangePressure. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the flange cover. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Pressure. Create a set named BOLT_HOLES and a surface named PRESSURE_FACE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh that captures the bolt holes and recessed pressure face without dense bolt-hole refinement; use C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed, and do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-BoltHoles that fixes all three translational degrees of freedom U1, U2, and U3 on BOLT_HOLES. Create a pressure load named Pressure-1MPa with positive magnitude approximately 1.0 MPa on PRESSURE_FACE. Request U, S, RF, NFORC and CF field output in Step-Pressure. Do not create any other active boundary conditions, loads, constraints or couplings, interactions, predefined fields, connector or assembly elements, or other analysis actions. Submit the job named Job-DxfFlangePressure and wait for the analysis to complete.
4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfFlangePressure.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfFlangePressure.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use AutoCAD to create the DXF profile, then use SolidWorks to import the DXF and export the STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; AutoCAD 2024 (English): `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024 - English.lnk`.
